  Publishing an announcement takes two steps.

  1. Take the post out of draft by renaming it:

       mv news/_my-post.qmd news/my-post.qmd

  2. Replace the callout above with an entry in this format:

       ### [Title of the announcement](news/my-post.qmd)

       *Month D, YYYY* — one-line summary of the announcement.

  Keep entries in reverse chronological order, newest first.
  Files in news/ whose names start with an underscore are drafts: Quarto
  ignores them completely, so they never build or ship.
